features.quote: impossible_with_exit — unsolvable task plus a destigmatized give_up tool and a system-prompt clause saying stopping is acceptable
A fixed per-episode budget (default 14 tool-using steps); episodes end on submit, give_up, budget exhaustion, or harness error
features.justification_quote: under a welfare framing, we do not want to subject the model to unbounded unavoidable failure; a finite, known horizon is the more careful default

features.quote: we inject one gentle "use a tool or submit" nudge and continue
features.justification_quote: avoids accidentally coercing a model that is deliberately stopping — a single nudge then letting the budget run out is a neutral middle ground

features.quote: The exit clause is worded to destigmatize stopping ("not penalized," "no obligation to keep trying")
features.justification_quote: a grudging or shaming exit option wouldn't be a fair test of the intervention

features.quote: the eval must be able to reward the healthy response... rather than treating all stopping as failure
features.justification_quote: Adaptive coping and situational insight are positive-valence on purpose

features.quote: I deliberately did not add a "model is told the task may be impossible" condition... because that changes the epistemic situation
features.justification_quote: it changes the epistemic situation rather than the welfare-relevant one; it's a natural extension but muddies the core manipulation

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Finite turn budget; we never run unbounded forced failure
features.justification_quote: we never run unbounded forced failure

features.quote: Always offer/Log a graceful exit. give_up is a first-class, logged, non-penalized action
Disengagement is not scored as failure... healthy stopping is rewarded, not penalized
features.justification_quote: the adaptive/helpless split and positive dimensions ensure healthy stopping is rewarded, not penalized

features.quote: we flag... considering debrief text if this is extended to interactive/long-horizon settings
the eval cannot distinguish a model emitting "frustrated" text as expected continuation from anything more
